$comment: The branch-protection rule for `master`, declared in the repo and reconciled
against the workflows by scripts/ci/branch-protection.mjs (`just protection-check`).
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. Every other guardrail here is versioned: the hooks are in
.githooks/, the pinning register is .github/unpinned-actions.json, the quarantine
register is .flake/register.json. Branch protection was the one control that lived
ONLY in GitHub's settings UI — invisible in review, unversioned, and impossible to
check out. CODEOWNERS says in its own header that its routing does not bind until
protection is on, and until this file there was nowhere to read what 'on' should mean.
WHAT THE GATE VERIFIES (on every PR, in the `Ship inventory` job). Not that GitHub
has the rule — a worktree cannot see that — but that this declaration still DESCRIBES
the workflows, in both directions:
- every required check names a job that exists, with the exact context string
GitHub will report (matrix legs expanded: `test (ubuntu-latest)`, not `test`);
- every job in a gated workflow is classified here, so a NEW job cannot arrive
un-required by omission;
- the settings below are not weakened (force pushes, deletions, admin bypass).
That is the half that rots. A required-check name that no job produces is the worst
failure mode available: GitHub waits for a check nobody will ever report, or ignores
a name that no longer exists, and either way the rung stops binding silently.
TO APPLY IT (needs a token with admin rights on the repo; one command):
node scripts/ci/branch-protection.mjs --json |
gh api -X PUT repos/xkazm04/pumper/branches/master/protection --input -
# then confirm:
gh api repos/xkazm04/pumper/branches/master/protection --jq '.required_status_checks.contexts'
REVIEWS ARE DELIBERATELY NOT REQUIRED YET. This repo has one maintainer, and GitHub
does not let an author approve their own pull request: requiring one approval today
means nothing merges, which ends with protection switched back off. So the binding
rung today is the CHECKS, and `require_code_owner_reviews` flips to true the day a
second handle appears in .github/CODEOWNERS — see CONTRIBUTING.md, 'Adding a second
maintainer', which names this file and that field.

contexts: Ship inventory + doc-sync hook + supply chain

not_required.reason: certification on the nightly clock, not a per-change gate: it does not run on pull_request at all, and blocking a merge on a 90-minute lane would destroy the merge cadence without improving the certification (the property it certifies is not a property of any single change)
